head_contract: os-v2 unified head (os/pagehead-redesign.html): 48px 3-zone topbar + icon-tile page head replaced by root-variant w2head (neutral 22px glyph + 13px title 'Home', live indicator as .w2-status[data-tone=ok], single primary 'New session' in .w2-actions); old head meta demoted to a 12px .pagemeta line at top of .page (named .pagemeta because .subhead was already taken by an in-content section label). Legacy topbar/breadcrumb/head CSS and selector references removed; rg sweep clean.

clarity.notes: Seven zones ordered by the end user's questions (needs me → glance → live → evidence → cost → fleet → system). Plain-language copy throughout; operator depth collapsed behind the System row and the CLI echo.

hierarchy.notes: Attention strip is the single entry point; one headline figure per chart panel; accent restricted to route icon, live dots, and the one primary Approve action. Uppercase 10.5px section labels carry the scan rhythm.

typography.notes: Token stack verbatim from agent-detail.html lineage; Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono strictly for numerics/ids/CLI; tabular-nums on every counter and timer.

motion.notes: KPI count-up (550ms, cubic ease-out), live pulse dots, ticking elapsed timers — all gated by prefers-reduced-motion. No decorative animation.

brand.notes: Signal palette used only as information: status colors in outcomes stack (color IS the data, neutral separator between green/red for CVD), monochrome data ink for magnitude charts (usage, heatmap, runtime bars). Cost labeled estimated; retention window labeled on 90d.

checks.p0_checklist: pass — tags balanced, no scrollIntoView, hex only in :root, data-od-id on all sections, mobile reflow at 1080/760/520, no filler or invented metrics
checks.dataviz_validator: status palette adjacent pair danger↔neutral fails CVD as categorical; mitigated by stack order completed→canceled→failed (neutral separates hues), 2px segment gaps, legend with counts, per-day tooltips
